summary.text: Mike Visconti is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Visconti advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, finishing first with 35.3 percent of the vote ahead of incumbent Ernesto Leonardo Gonzalez.

paragraphs.text: Visconti previously ran for the state House as a Republican.
In 2018 he advanced from the Republican primary for Merrimack 14 and was defeated in the general election by incumbent Jim MacKay.
In 2020 he and Japhet Stevens advanced from the Republican primary for Merrimack 27, and incumbents Rebecca McWilliams and Art Ellison defeated them in the general election.
